Vehicle.title: Vehicle
Vehicle.description: A company car's fiscal facts (fleet-bijtelling): cataloguswaarde, fuelType, and bijtellingCategorie -- the inputs the monthly bijtelling privegebruik auto (Wet LB 1964 art. 13bis) formula needs. Deliberately decoupled from the custody-tracking Asset/AssetAssignment pair (hr-assets.json, category voertuig): an employee's company car MAY also be tracked as an Asset for custody purposes, or may not be -- neither schema references the other (design.md D1). No x-openregister-lifecycle: a plain fiscal-facts record, no workflow.

name.title: Name
name.description: Human label for the vehicle, e.g. "Tesla Model Y".

kenteken.title: Kenteken
kenteken.description: Dutch licence plate. Purely descriptive here -- no fiscal meaning is attached to the plate itself, only to cataloguswaarde/bijtellingCategorie below.

cataloguswaarde.title: Cataloguswaarde
cataloguswaarde.description: The fiscal catalog value in EUR -- the base the monthly bijtelling percentage is applied against (fleet-bijtelling design.md D3).

fuelType.title: Fuel type
fuelType.description: Descriptive fuel type. Does not by itself select the bijtelling rate -- bijtellingCategorie does. Enum append-only: renaming a value later is breaking, adding one is not.

bijtellingCategorie.title: Bijtelling categorie
bijtellingCategorie.description: The fiscal classification selecting which nl-{year}.json bijtellingPrivegebruikAuto rate/cap row applies: standaard = the flat standardPercent rate over the full cataloguswaarde; elektrischGeplafonneerd = the reduced evReducedPercent rate up to evReducedCataloguswaardeCap, standardPercent on the excess (fleet-bijtelling design.md D3). Enum append-only -- the hydrogen/fully-solar uncapped rate and grijs-kenteken/bestelauto regimes are named non-goals, not modelled by an enum value here yet.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: Denormalized administratie key this Vehicle is scoped to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7, the Asset precedent): a Vehicle has no single owning employee, so nl-administratie-scope-consistency does not evaluate this schema. Maintained by HR/back-office.

CarAssignment.title: Car assignment
CarAssignment.description: An effective-dated assignment of one Vehicle to one Employee for private use (fleet-bijtelling, the AssetAssignment/OrgAssignment effective-dating pattern): effectiveFrom required, effectiveTo nullable = ongoing. PayrollRunService resolves the employee's open CarAssignment covering the run period (the coveringContract()/openSickCaseFor() precedent) and folds its bijtelling into the taxable gross BEFORE the calculator runs. eigenBijdrage is the employee's own monthly contribution for private use (Wet LB 1964 art. 13bis lid 5), which reduces the computed bijtelling. No x-openregister-lifecycle: a plain effective-dated record, no workflow -- mirrors AssetAssignment, not the guarded Loonbeslag state machine.

vehicleId.title: Vehicle
vehicleId.description: UUID reference to the assigned Vehicle.

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.description: UUID reference to the receiving Employee.

effectiveFrom.title: Effective from
effectiveFrom.description: First period this assignment covers (effective-dating per the OrgAssignment/AssetAssignment pattern).

effectiveTo.title: Effective to
effectiveTo.description: Last period this assignment covers, or null while ongoing.

eigenBijdrage.title: Eigen bijdrage
eigenBijdrage.description: The employee's own monthly contribution (EUR) for private use of the car (Wet LB 1964 art. 13bis lid 5). Subtracted from the computed monthly bijtelling, floored at zero -- never a negative bijtelling (fleet-bijtelling design.md D3).

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: Denormalized administratie key this CarAssignment is scoped to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7), mirroring the receiving employee's administrationId; maintained by HR/back-office (the AssetAssignment precedent).
